core: Thanks, amigo! Great to connect. Yes, I'll be supporting the Access products in GT. I'm sure we'll work closely together on the homologations. I'll reach out if I need any help.
meaning_cn: 谢谢，朋友！很高兴认识你。是的，我会负责支持危地马拉的接入产品。我相信后续我们会在认证测试方面有很多合作。如果我需要帮助，我会联系你。
explanation_cn: 回复新同事主动提供支持时，可以先用 Great to connect 表达建立联系，再确认自己的职责，并用 I'm sure we'll work closely together 表达后续协作预期。I'll reach out if I need any help 是回应对方 if you need any help let me know 的自然说法。homologation 在拉美电信团队中常用于设备认证/入网测试语境，因此这里保留业务用词。
source_sentence: Yucao told me you're going to be helping us with the Access products in GT. I'm the lab engineer where all the homologations happen so if you need any help let me know!

examples.en: Great to connect. I'm sure we'll work closely together on the upcoming tests.
examples.cn: 很高兴认识你，我相信我们会在后续测试中密切合作。

examples.en: I'll reach out if I need any help with the homologation process.
examples.cn: 如果认证流程方面需要帮助，我会联系你。

examples.en: Thanks for offering to help. I'll definitely keep in touch.
examples.cn: 谢谢你主动提供帮助，我会保持联系。

pronunciation.text: Thanks, amigo! Great to connect. Yes, I'll be supporting the Access products in GT. I'm sure we'll work closely together on the homologations. I'll reach out if I need any help.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 Great to connect、supporting、work closely together、homologations 和 reach out；整体保持同事间轻松友好的语气。
